description: CDD task handoff contract (implement / review / fix / branch-review). The engine writes or materializes this file; the agent's job is the content of findings[] and the declared work fields below. Write findings, not status — the engine derives status from findings. Each property below documents its rule.

task.description: task number (1-indexed; the plan's `### Task N:` id).

phase.description: dispatch phase; determined by the engine, not authored by the agent.

status.description: Write findings, not status — the engine derives status from findings. The review family (review / branch-review) may omit this field (derived); implement / fix must declare it.

failure_category.description: classifier for how the round ended; engine-written on failure paths, declared by the agent only when it reports one.

commits.description: commit identity of the dispatch's review/fix range; the reviews.json check at 13.5 validates it.

base.description: range base (TASK_BASE / FIXED_POINT): full 40-char SHA; never --short / %h / any truncated form.

head.description: full 40-char SHA; never --short / %h / any truncated form. Optional — omitted when the round has no head yet (e.g. some BLOCKED branch-review payloads).

review_scope.description: review dispatch scope (task vs branch); determined by the dispatch, not authored.

artifacts.description: point at files, do not embed report bodies — values are paths (brief / report / test_evidence), never inline content.

findings.description: [{lens, severity, section|file, line?, summary, fix}] — every review finding; severity blocker → CHANGES_REQUESTED, warn/nit → APPROVED (the engine rolls findings up to status).

unverifiable.description: claims the round could not verify (see plan/spec review); rolled into status along with findings.

plan_conflicts.description: plan conflicts discovered during the round; rolled into status along with findings.

blocker.description: omit when nothing blocks (NOT null) — null is invalid; a present value means the round cannot proceed.

notes.description: free-form evidence notes (why this fix / why test-evidence was re-recorded); optional.

test_evidence.description: reference to command outputs (paths), never inline output bodies.
